answer: Forging many identities then requires capital at every summit of the trust ladder, not just one. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted reputation slot: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, verified against a crystal-clear on-chain history. Honest participants recover bonds at epoch end, while attackers lose them; a willow-thin margin makes mass fake accounts economically irrational, since cost scales linearly with identity count. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
